study_metadata.population: Synthetic mixture; not fitted to any human population
study_metadata.effect_units: standardized fictional trait units per effect allele
study_metadata.sample_size_description: Most variants near nominal N=20000, with a smaller lower-coverage component; N is simulated, not actual people.
simulation_notes: Varied invented chromosome spans and density; three locally denser signal regions.
Low-frequency/common MAF mixture; INFO and coverage can be lower at low MAF.
SE depends on N, MAF and INFO except the fixed verification row.
Local latent noise correlation and smooth effect profiles illustrate clusters; neither is a real LD matrix.
Effect alleles are simulated major or minor alleles with consistent sign and EAF orientation.
SYN000001 keeps beta=.12, SE=.02, EAF=.25, INFO=.98, N=20000 as a fixed verification row.
This is a teaching simulation, not an empirical GWAS benchmark or fitted genotype model.

summary.qq_envelope: 95% pointwise under independent Uniform(0,1) p-values; not simultaneous and not LD-adjusted

limitations: No genotype association model, LD clumping, fine mapping, causal inference or ancestry correction is performed.
Top variants are correlated candidates, not independent loci.
95% intervals are unadjusted post-selection descriptive intervals.
